sum: Narragansett Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company that provides various banking and financial services to individuals and businesses in the United States. The company offers personal checking services, such as Active, Direct, Free, Preferred, Senior/Minor, Compare checking accounts, and Honor Checking and Veteran Banking services; savings services, including statement savings, savings club, certificates of deposit, money market accounts, and investing; lending services, including personal loans, mortgage loans, manufactured and mobile homes, home equity lines of credit, home equity loans, home improvement loans, HEAT loans, auto loans, and online loan payments; and online banking services, such as mobile banking, eStatements, purchase rewards, money management, and easy money transfers. It also offers ATM/debit cards, bounce protection, credit cards, interactive teller machines, safe deposit boxes, foreign currency exchange, and insurance services. Additionally, it offers business checking services, such as Free Business Checking, Business Analysis Checking, Right Fit Checking, Municipal/Non-Profit Checking, and Compare checking accounts; business savings plans, including statement savings, business money market access, certificates of deposit, retirement plans, business IRAs, and Plimoth Investment; and lending services, such as commercial lending, Providence Lending Office, business lines and loans, small business lending, business development partnerships, Invest MA, and online loan payments. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is based in Swansea, Massachusetts.
